title: The Deep Cipher
author: F. M. Montrose
blurb: Ansel Oyelaran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
